title: Recurring Services under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing: Start and Cancellation Terms
content:
Recurring services under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing are started and stopped on the same two terms in every ancillary account tier, from Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing through Ancillary Account, Hospice Election.

| Term | Setting (every tier) |
|---|---|
| A recurring service started mid-month | Charged by daily proration by the days in the month |
| A cancelled recurring service | Stops being charged at the end of the month of the request; a discharge ends it on the discharge date |

- **Start.** The first, partial month of a service is prorated by days: the days charged over the days in that month.
- **Cancellation.** A cancellation requested at any point in a month leaves the service charged to the end of that month.
- **Discharge.** A discharge ends the service on the discharge date itself.
